module: Submodule of the third-party Copas library: limits the number of tasks run simultaneously. Each added task is scheduled right away if there is room (otherwise queued); wait lets you wait for all of them to finish. The module returns { new = new }.
usage:
local limit = require("libs/copas/copas/limit")
local r = limit.new(5)
r:addthread(function(url) --[[ ... ]] end, "http://...")
r:wait()
notes: The object returned by new has the methods addthread(task, ...), removethread(coro), next() and wait(); addthread returns the coroutine, and rethrows the error of a task that fails.

new.desc: Creates a task runner with at most maxt simultaneous tasks.

returns.desc: Runner with addthread, removethread, next, wait

ll.desc: Internal linked list serving as the task queue.

push.desc: Adds an element at the end of the list.

pop.desc: Removes and returns the first element (nil if empty).

remove.desc: Removes a given element from the list.
